description:
Open Source Maintainer — Paid Role at Thornlake Foundation

Thornlake is a small foundation that funds the long-term maintenance of critical open-source libraries used in the European public sector. We're hiring a maintainer to own a single package full-time for two years (renewable).

The package in question is a TypeScript-first validation library with ~40M npm downloads / month. You'd inherit it from the current maintainer who is stepping back for health reasons.

The job
- Triage issues and PRs. Today there's an 800-issue backlog. Do not panic; we'll pair the first month.
- Own the release cadence. A stable 1-month minor release, a quarterly major review.
- Write the quarterly release letter. It goes to 6000 users. Yes, a newsletter.
- Host the community. Run the Discord. Show up.

Requirements
- You have maintained a popular open-source package for at least 2 years. You do not need to be a household name — you need to have done the work.
- Deep TypeScript. Bonus if you've worked with Zod, Valibot, Effect Schema.
- You are comfortable saying 'no' in public and having people be disappointed.
- Europe time zones preferred for meeting overlap.
